tool_calls.name: exec
tool_calls.input:
const cmds = [
  tools.exec_command({
    cmd: `python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from tools.i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from tools.i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from tools.i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime

root = Path.cwd()
manifest = load_manifest()
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(manifest))
baseline_bytes = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "HEAD:tome-orcs.lua"])
current_bytes = (root / "tome-orcs.lua").read_bytes()
baseline = loader.load_bytes(baseline_bytes, logical_path="tome-orcs.lua").translations
current = loader.load_bytes(current_bytes, logical_path="tome-orcs.lua").translations
assert len(baseline) == len(current), (len(baseline), len(current))
changed = []
for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(baseline, current)):
    if before == after:
        continue
    keys = set(before) | set(after)
    non_target = {key: (before.get(key), after.get(key)) for key in keys if key != "target" and before.get(key) != after.get(key)}
